meta.title: Yahtzee CPU Match-W head-to-head benchmark
meta.rules: Repo rules: +35 upper bonus at 63; +100 extra Yahtzee after a 50; an extra Yahtzee may be banked in any open box.
meta.sample: 100 complete head-to-head games against the CPU policy used by the browser.

summary.modelNote: Player: Exact-W. CPU: Exact-W through round 11, then Match-W (P(win) + 0.5*P(tie)) in rounds 12-13 with the human modelled as Exact-W. Exact dice enumeration; no browser and no LLM in the decision loop.
